Batch load files from a directory or ZIP

Source: R/batch_load.r
ks_batch_load.Rd

Loads all files of one type from a directory (or .zip) in batch. Supported types are csv, xlsx, xpt, and rds. Results can be returned as a named list, assigned to .GlobalEnv, saved as individual .rds, and/or saved as one .RData.

Usage

ks_batch_load(
  data,
  type = c("csv", "xlsx", "xpt", "rds"),
  save.path = NULL,
  keep = FALSE,
  save.rdata = NULL,
  with_length = FALSE,
  recursive = FALSE
)

Arguments

data

Path to a directory or a .zip file.

type

One of "csv", "xlsx", "xpt", "rds".

save.path

Optional directory where loaded objects are saved as .rds.

keep

If TRUE, assign loaded objects into .GlobalEnv.

save.rdata

Optional path to a .RData file.

with_length

Passed to foreign::read.csv3 for CSV loading.

recursive

If TRUE, search recursively under data.

Value

Named list of loaded objects.
